rv.q: This production will give you pause, make you laugh and cry.
This must see version of Fiddler on the Roof is only playing Wednesday through Sunday until August 17th at the George Van Dusen Theatre in the North Shore Center for the Performing Arts, 9501.
Walter Stearns and Eugene Dizon’s charming production gives Chicagoland the opportunity to discover, or rediscover, this warm, wonderful story about family, friends and faith.
Music Theatre Works’ production brought this struggle for balance to life with both humor and heart to North Shore Center for the Performing Arts.
From my first encounter with Tevye and his town, at sixteen, to now, this show never fails to capture my heart.
Sam Nachison is remarkable as Tevye, perfect in stature and voice, with great instincts for both the comedic and tragic in this story.
The "Bottle Dance" during the wedding scene is magnificent, and the ensemble does a wonderful job.
This richly-staged production by Music Theater Works is now playing at the George Van Dusen Theatre, North Shore Center for the Performing Arts in Skokie, Illinois...
This version, directed by L. Walter Stearns, is as good as any I have seen (and I have seen several).
